blocks.html: In underground buildings complying with Section 405 where the lowest level of a structure is more than 30 feet (9144 mm) below the lowest level of exit discharge, the structure shall be equipped throughout with a manual and automatic fire alarm system, including an emergency voice/alarm communication system installed in accordance with Section 907.5.2.2.
